item.title: Zodiac (ride)
item.description: Zodiac is a HUSS Enterprise flat ride located at Thorpe Park in Surrey, United Kingdom. The attraction features a large rotating disc with suspended gondolas that seat two riders each. As the disc spins and is gradually lifted by a hydraulic arm, riders experience a combination of rotational and tilting forces, creating near-inversions and high G-forces.
